strengths.text: Theo trang của YESSS Electrical: cung cấp tổ máy Baudouin, Cummins với đầu phát Leroy-Somer, bộ điều khiển Deep Sea

missing: Chưa tìm được website chính thức; chưa rõ là nhà lắp ráp hay nhà cung cấp
Hàng chào trúng thầu: L1800S 1.700 kVA, nhãn 'Haco Power generator' (gói IB2600116950)

quote: Lance Power supplied and installed a 1,000 kVA Baudouin diesel generator complete with a Leroy-Somer alternator, Deep Sea Electronics controller, and ABB circuit breakers.
The generator supplied was powered by a Cummins 6LTAA 8.9-G2 engine and paired with a Leroy-Somer alternator and DSE7320 controller
Thanks to Lance Power’s UK stock holding
Lance Power is a UK-based global provider of industrial power solutions, specialising in diesel
Model 6ZTAA13-G2 QSZ13-G5 KTAA19-G5 KT38-GA KTA38-G2B KTA38-G5

The generator supplied was a 250kVA soundproof diesel generator , built using a Cummins 6LTAA 8.9-G2, paired with a Leroy-Somer alternator and controlled via a DSE7320 controller. This combination ensures high performance, fuel efficiency, and reliable standby power for demanding applications.

At 14:00 on a Thursday, our team received an urgent enquiry for a 250kVA standby diesel generator. The requirement called for immediate availability, rapid preparation, and full compliance with industry standards.
